usageNote: Tool context exposes no reliable per-agent billable tokens or cost; null is intentional.
blindness: Read only standards, manifest and assigned frozen inputs; no worker outputs accessed.

severityDefinition.moderate: meaningful reproducibility, timing, scaling or instructional defect

sources.claim: Use pasteurized eggs or egg products for recipes using raw or undercooked eggs.
sources.applicability: Carbonara has only warmth and residual heat as endpoints. Source supports pasteurization strategy; does not validate this carbonara process or establish its attained temperature.

globalObservations: All twelve lack complete recipe-specific learning/storage/review source material demanded for an eventual editorial review. This blind defect pass does not authorize review-status changes.
Legacy nutrition is internally implausible in many inputs and withheld from public display per standard. Do not preserve it as verified or recompute without complete quantities.
Unsupported historical and mechanism claims are flagged as unknowns where not needed to resolve a material method decision.
Scaling findings distinguish known fixed prose from hypothetical interface behavior; UI testing was not performed.
No replacement quantities, duplicate decisions, external authorship or recipe edits were invented.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: Pasta -> boil/toss; ricotta, measured oil, Pecorino, lemon juice/zest, flakes -> bowl; basil/pepper -> finish; salt -> pasta water. Extra final oil is not separately allocated. Reserved water is generated, 1 cup maximum, 1/4 cup initially used.
recipes.processAccounting: Boil pasta, reserve water, mix sauce, toss off heat, serve. Four main portions from 1 lb dry pasta plausible. No roasting. Doubling requires larger bowl/pot; method water amounts remain fixed.

materialFindings.evidence: Cook pasta ... for 1 minute **less** than the package instructions. / Add the hot pasta to the bowl.
materialFindings.finding: Pasta is deliberately undercooked but finishes in an unheated bowl without a final doneness check; ensure intended tenderness rather than assuming a hot bowl supplies a minute of boiling.

materialFindings.evidence: totalTime: 15 min / cookTime: 10 min
materialFindings.finding: No water-heating allowance or package-dependent range; 15 minutes is conditional on equipment/hot water and pasta choice.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Confirm peeled ricotta moisture and desired oil richness by cooking; 1/2 cup oil is not inherently an error and must not be silently reduced.
Confirm whether finish oil is additional or reserved from the listed quantity.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Lemon, ricotta, Pecorino, olive oil, basil; bowl-bound sauce; do not replace defining richness.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: Pasta -> boil; pork including rendered fat -> skillet; 2 whole eggs + 2 yolks -> bowl (2 whites unused by design); cheese/pepper -> eggs; salt -> water. Listed 1-2 lemons have no destination. Extra serving cheese/pepper unquantified.
recipes.processAccounting: Render while boiling; warm egg bowl over boiling pot for 1 minute; skillet off heat; drain/toss eggs with pasta and water. Four main portions plausible; residual-heat process is sensitive to scaling and pan/bowl temperature.

materialFindings.evidence: '--- Lemon juice ---' / '1-2 Lemons, juiced'
materialFindings.finding: Lemons are unassigned in all seven steps and appear as a detached section. Resolve whether erroneous addition before deleting or incorporating; either changes the edible formula.

materialFindings.evidence: Place the bowl over the pot of boiling pasta for 1 minute ... until ... warm / The heat from the pasta will finish cooking the eggs
materialFindings.finding: Warmth and residual pasta heat do not establish a safe egg endpoint. Eggs are not specified pasteurized; replace the unqualified assurance with a supported safe approach. Source egg-safety applies to lightly cooked eggs; no measured endpoint or kitchen validation exists.

materialFindings.evidence: 4 large Eggs (2 whole, 2 yolks)
materialFindings.finding: Leading total can scale while parenthetical whole/yolk counts remain fixed; egg split must remain consistent at each supported serving setting.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Resolve lemon provenance from source history if editing; frozen recipe alone cannot establish intent.
Historical 1940s/coal-miner claims and absolute ban on bacon are unsupported; avoid manufacturing history or authenticity evidence.
Check final pasta tenderness: 1 minute short has no maintained-heat finish.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Pork, egg, hard cheese, pepper, no cream. Preserve guanciale/pancetta options and title; lemon anomaly unresolved.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: Butter -> melt; cream/garlic -> simmer; Parmesan -> low heat; pasta water -> whisk; nutmeg/salt/pepper -> season. Lemons unassigned. Cooked pasta required in final step but neither quantity nor ingredient supplied.
recipes.processAccounting: Seven-minute sauce assumes already hot cooked pasta and its reserved water. Four sauce servings have no coverage quantity. Scaling sauce alone is possible, but pasta dependency/yield undefined.

materialFindings.evidence: '--- Lemon juice ---' / '1-2 Lemons, juiced'
materialFindings.finding: Detached lemons have no method destination; resolve before deletion or addition.

materialFindings.evidence: 1/4 cup Reserved Pasta Water / Add your hot, cooked pasta directly to the skillet / servings: '4'
materialFindings.finding: As a base sauce it can exclude pasta cooking time, but needs an explicit cooked-pasta dependency and supported coverage amount. No pasta amount establishes four portions.

materialFindings.evidence: advancePrep: ... make-ahead / leftovers: good
materialFindings.finding: Make-ahead promise has no cooling, storage, reheating or emulsion-recovery guidance.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Establish intended pasta coverage without guessing a weight.
Verify fresh garlic option cooks sufficiently in brief simmer; do not equate grated garlic and powder without flavor review.
Historical heat-lamp/1960s assertion lacks evidence and is unnecessary to method.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Cream-based Americanized Alfredo, butter/Parmesan, garlic and optional nutmeg; preserve deliberate richness.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: All six ingredients accounted: noodles boil, butter/water/salt/pepper toss, optional parsley finish. Pasta-water salt is additional and unspecified.
recipes.processAccounting: Bring water to boil, noodles 7-8 min, drain and toss 30-60 sec. Four side portions from 12 oz plausible; larger batches need pot/toss capacity.

materialFindings.evidence: The water should taste like the sea. / 1 tsp Kosher Salt (plus more for pasta water) / Add ... salt
materialFindings.finding: Sea-water analogy plus fixed finishing salt and salted reserved water can oversalt; specify a controllable seasoning approach. Salt density is unresolved, so do not invent a replacement weight.

materialFindings.evidence: totalTime: 12 min / Bring a large pot ... to a rolling boil
materialFindings.finding: Twelve-minute elapsed claim gives little water-heating allowance; qualify or establish actual elapsed time.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Test preferred finishing salt after accounting for water salinity.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Simple buttered wide egg noodles with optional parsley; no need to add cheese or richer sauce.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: All nine ingredients have destinations: wet banana/butter/sugar/eggs/vanilla; dry flour/soda/salt; nuts or seeds folded. Butter cooling occurs both ingredient prep and method; no lost ingredient.
recipes.processAccounting: 9x5 loaf; mix then bake 55-60 min; pan rest 10 min; wire rack. Ten slices plausible. Recipe doubling needs separate pans or tested geometry, not double loaf thickness.

materialFindings.evidence: prepTime: 15 min / cookTime: 55 min / totalTime: 70 min / Bake for 55-60 minutes / Let cool ... for 10 minutes
materialFindings.finding: Elapsed time omits mandatory pan cooling and upper bake range; at least 80-85 minutes using stated prep, before further rack cooling.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Clarify banana 375g as peeled edible mash; weighing note currently does not say whether skins included.
Establish slice-ready rack cooling and pan material/depth if reproducibility is required.
Nut/seed option preserves texture intent but seed version changes title expectations; do not remove option automatically.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Banana nut loaf with melted butter and walnut/sunflower option; retain 9x5 geometry.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: All nine batter/berry ingredients assigned. 3/4 cup berries = 12 tbsp matches twelve toppings of 1 tbsp. Greasing butter and serving butter/syrup are additional, unlisted.
recipes.processAccounting: Heat griddle, whisk 2-3 min, mix, rest 5 min, cook 4 min per pancake batch. Twelve 1/4-cup portions imply about 3 cups batter; yield requires cooking confirmation. Scaling requires batch count.

materialFindings.evidence: cookingMethods: ... no-cook / Cook for 2 minutes ... Flip and cook for another 2 minutes
materialFindings.finding: No-cook tag contradicts griddle cooking and misclassifies method.

materialFindings.evidence: cookTime: 15 min / large non-stick skillet / servings: 12 pancakes
materialFindings.finding: 15-minute cooking depends on at least roughly four pancakes per batch (3 batches x 4 min plus handling). Skillet capacity is unspecified; small skillet will take longer.

materialFindings.evidence: 3 tbsp Unsalted Butter, melted and cooled / Lightly grease with butter.
materialFindings.finding: All measured butter goes into batter; greasing needs an explicitly additional amount/as-needed declaration to prevent subtraction from batter.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Verify twelve pancakes at stated scoop; do not infer serving diners from pancake count.
Lumps are not mandatory; avoid instructing cook to retain dry flour pockets.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Honey-sweetened, fresh blueberries placed individually; preserve berry allocation.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: All nine ingredients accounted in dry/wet mixes and vanilla fold. Grease and serving toppings are extra unlisted.
recipes.processAccounting: Mix, rest 10-15 min, then preheat iron, portion 1/3-1/2 cup, cook until steam ceases/golden. Six servings lacks waffle count/iron capacity. Scaling adds batches.

materialFindings.evidence: servings: '6' / cookTime: 10 min / Pour about 1/3 to 1/2 cup ... Cook until the steam stops
materialFindings.finding: No waffle count, iron type/capacity or per-batch time supports six servings and ten-minute cooking; complete-batch timing cannot be audited.

materialFindings.evidence: prepTime: 10 min / totalTime: 30 min / rest ... 10-15 minutes / Preheat your waffle iron
materialFindings.finding: Prep + rest + claimed cooking already totals 30-35 minutes, with preheating placed after rest. Total is an optimistic minimum and dependencies need clarification.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Confirm pour volume and waffle yield on specified iron, including whether indicator/steam cue is appropriate; do not invent a universal iron cook time.
Check butter temperature when mixing with cold buttermilk; lump claim should not require dry flour pockets.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Buttermilk, butter, eggs, soda plus baking powder; vanilla. Preserve formula pending physical test.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: All ten ingredients assigned: sugar split 2 cups minus 2 tbsp + remaining 2 tbsp; butter/eggs/milk/vanilla wet; flour/powder/salt dry; berries fold; nutmeg topping. No missing sugar.
recipes.processAccounting: Two 12-cup tins, 375F, cream 3-5 min then mix/fill, bake 20-25 min, cool 10 min. Twenty-four muffins plausible but cup size and fill require test.

materialFindings.evidence: totalTime: 30 min / Bake for 20-25 minutes / Let sit in the pan for 10 minutes
materialFindings.finding: Ten-minute mandatory cooling omitted; stated prep plus bake plus rest = 40-45 min, excluding further rack cooling.

materialFindings.evidence: 2 cups Granulated Sugar (divided) / 2 cups minus 2 tbsp / remaining 2 tbsp
materialFindings.finding: Method fixed sugar arithmetic fails when ingredient list is scaled. Both batter and topping allocations need ratio-consistent guidance.

materialFindings.evidence: advancePrep: ... make-ahead ... freeze-ahead / leftovers: excellent
materialFindings.finding: Freezing/make-ahead promises lack cooling, packing, duration and thawing guidance.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Confirm standard muffin cup size and two-tin oven arrangement/rotation; lower rack batch may brown differently.
Frozen berries defining identity stays; claim they always maintain better texture is unverified.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Frozen unsweetened berries and nutmeg sugar topping, creamed butter method; do not turn into melted-butter batter.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: Asparagus/oil/salt/pepper -> toss/roast; lemon -> finish; Parmesan or zest -> finish optional. All assigned.
recipes.processAccounting: Dry, single layer 425F 8-12 min, tender-crisp/brown tips. Four portions cannot be assessed from unweighted bunch; scaling depends on sheet area.

materialFindings.evidence: 1 bunch Fresh Asparagus, woody ends trimmed / servings: '4'
materialFindings.finding: Bunch has no weight and stalk thickness is unspecified; amount, salt ratio and portion yield are not reproducible. Resolve quantity without inventing weight.

materialFindings.evidence: Steaming it or cooking at low heat turns it gray and mushy. / evaporates surface moisture instantly
materialFindings.finding: Absolute steaming and instantaneous-evaporation claims misteach method: the text gives no time/thickness limits or supporting source; remove absolutes rather than assert a universal alternative.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Establish thin/medium/thick stalk guidance and bunch weight in a cook test.
15-minute total assumes rapid preheat and middle of 8-12 minute range; clarify elapsed dependence.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Simple lemon-finished roasted asparagus; optional Parmesan/zest preserved.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: All eight entries assigned: mixed roots/oil/salt/pepper/garlic/herbs toss; syrup or honey and balsamic final glaze. Two sheets share single total glaze; clarify distribution if needed.
recipes.processAccounting: Four pounds 1-inch roots on two sheets, 425F 35-40 min, toss halfway, glaze final 5 min. Six large side portions plausible; scaling requires proportional pan area.

materialFindings.evidence: cut all ... equal 1-inch chunks so they cook at the same rate / Carrots, Parsnips, Sweet Potatoes, Beets / until the edges are dark brown and crispy
materialFindings.finding: Equal dimensions do not guarantee equal tenderness across these vegetables. Method tests only edges; add interior-tenderness assessment and resolve beet/mixed-root variation rather than promise one timing fits all.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Specify sheet dimensions/oven arrangement and whether rotate racks for four pounds.
Confirm final-five-minute glaze is included in 35-40, not added after fully completed roast.
Do not invent proportions of roots; test representative mixture and late additions/batch separation if needed.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Mixed root vegetables, herbs, garlic, maple/honey and balsamic glaze.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: Sweet potatoes plus all eight seasoning/oil entries -> toss; cilantro/lime -> finish. Cayenne declared optional but method should repeat optional qualifier. No ingredient loss.
recipes.processAccounting: 425F preheated lined sheet, spaced wedges flat-side down; 20 min + 10-12 min after flip; fork-creamy interior. Four portions plausible, two sheets as needed; larger batch requires area and rotation.
unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Clarify 3/4-inch as wedge thickness at widest point for reproducibility.
Lower-rack direct-bottom-heat explanation is oven dependent; confirm rack position in tested oven.
30-32 minute roast versus cookTime 30 is minor range rounding, not a major defect.
Verify manufacturer guidance for preheating loose parchment on the sheet; not classified as a confirmed material defect without product-specific evidence.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Cumin-chili-smoked-paprika wedges with cilantro/lime; no quantity reduction justified.

recipes.ingredientAccounting: Potatoes -> boil/smash; oil/garlic/herbs/salt/pepper -> season; flaky salt -> finish. All assigned; water salt and seasoning salt separate uses with amounts to taste.
recipes.processAccounting: Cold-water start, boil 15-20 min, smash 1/2 inch, dry 5 min, roast 25-30 min. Oven preheat begins after boil. Four side portions plausible. Expanded smashed area requires spacing/pans.

materialFindings.evidence: cookTime: 40 min / totalTime: 50 min / cook for 15-20 minutes / sit for 5 minutes / Bake for 25-30 minutes
materialFindings.finding: Boil + roast alone spans 40-50 min; mandatory drying adds 5, and cold-water heat-up, smashing and potentially oven preheat add more. Fifty-minute total does not honestly represent method upper bound/dependencies.

materialFindings.evidence: Place potatoes on the sheet / about 1/2-inch thick
materialFindings.finding: Smashed potatoes need nonoverlapping area for crisp edges; sheet dimensions/spacing or second-sheet instruction absent, especially under scaling.

unresolvedCulinaryQuestions: Define baby potato approximate diameter so boil timing can be reproduced.
Determine whether oven preheat can overlap boil and measured elapsed time on intended equipment.
recipes.preservedIdentity: Whole baby red/Yukon potatoes boiled, smashed, dried and roasted; oil/herbs, no dairy addition.
